question: Which stroke is C-0023's 40 pN/nm compliance ceiling owed at, and is §3's desired ~10 nm stroke reachable by any coupling this programme has?
conventions: the stroke s = L0 - h is positive DOWNWARD, toward the electrode
L0 is a FORCE-ONSET height (C-0011, CH-0010)
a coupling reaction R(s) is positive UPWARD; placement is written on its SECANT and stability on its TANGENT (C-0017)
every requirement below is quoted with the stroke it is read at — that is T-107
a stability tangent is minimised over [s_placement, s_read], never over a range containing zero stroke (CH-0047)

citedInputs.duplex EI: 230.0 pN·nm^2 (CanDo MODEL INPUT, not a measurement)
citedInputs.§3 targets: 100 pN, 3 nm acceptable, ~10 nm desired, 40 x 40 nm, 5/7/10 nm, 2 mM

verdict.T-107 — the stroke the ceiling is owed a: the PLACEMENT stroke, 3 nm. 40 pN/nm is 1.2 x (100 pN / 3 nm): a DECLARED linearity tolerance on the placement discharge, carrying its stroke inside it. Neither C-0017 nor C-0018 contains any upper bound on a coupling tangent — placement is an EQUALITY on the secant, stability a FLOOR on the tangent, and C-0032 measures a stiffer tangent RAISING C-0018's pull-in margin. The same construction at §3's desired clause is 12 pN/nm, not 40
verdict.T-107 — what replaces it beyond the work: the per-path unzip allowable, which is a bound on a FORCE and therefore tightens as 1/s: 45.0 pN/nm at 45 paths and 15.0 at C-0041's buildable 15. C-0039's E5a16 secant at 10 nm, 69.94, is past both — so relaxing the declared ceiling moves the miss from 6.6x on the tangent to 1.55x and 4.66x on a CITED allowable, and does not move the verdict
verdict.T-107 — the same answer applied to the F: a device placed at 3 nm traverses [0, 3] and never occupies the stroke CH-0042's minimum is taken at. at 45 paths the tangent at the placement stroke is 25.227 pN/nm and clears 4 of 6 of C-0017's 2 mM floors, against 22.875 at s = 4.556 nm clearing 0; at 15 paths the tangent at the placement stroke is 25.490 pN/nm and clears 4 of 6 of C-0017's 2 mM floors, against 22.507 at s = 5.066 nm clearing 0
verdict.T-108 — is the desired stroke reachable: NO, and the binding bound contains no coupling at all. The stroke is L0 - h, so s < L0 <= 10 nm at every height §3 names: a 10 nm stroke on a 10 nm layer IS h = 0. The best kinematic ceiling anywhere in the sweep is 9.790 nm, the best inside C-0002's validity range 8.959 nm, and the best under §3's own 100 pN 7.424 nm — and a coupling can only reduce the last
verdict.T-108 — catalogue at the acceptable stro: 3 of 14 rows clear every predicate: E3a transverse flexure, ends free (15 paths); E5 crossover-hinge flexure (1 crossover, rigid arm); E5a1 two-spring elastica arm
verdict.T-108 — which statement is established: unreachable ON §3's OWN STACK, which is stronger than 'unreachable with this catalogue' and weaker than 'unreachable in physics'. The escape is a TALLER LAYER: alexander-box(two-body) 21.21 nm; alexander-box(virial) 26.12 nm; alexander-box(des-Cloizeaux) 26.07 nm; strong-stretching(two-body) 16.63 nm; strong-stretching(virial) 19.48 nm; strong-stretching(des-Cloizeaux) 19.59 nm for a 10 nm stroke at 100 pN
verdict.§6 task 3: UNAFFECTED. Its acceptance predicate is 'stroke >= ~3 nm and force >= 100 pN at <= 2 V, or a demonstration that it is unreachable'. The 3 nm clause is delivered (C-0012, C-0017); the ~10 nm figure is a §3 TARGET row, not a §6 predicate, and what is filed here is §7's 'stated plainly'
